<page>
 Kennedy & Johnson LLP
 Sugar Land, TX
 Phone 832-555-5054
 Letter of Representation
19 Mar 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1463
Our client: Diana Burgess
Date of loss: 17 Mar 2024
Dear Claims Representative:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents our client in connection with a sideswipe collision that occurred while our
client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is pursuing a claim for the losses that followed. Please
direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone,
mail, or in person.
To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request a written disclosure of the bodily injury liability limits under each policy
that may apply to the insured driver, including any excess or umbrella coverage. Please also confirm the name of the adjuster
assigned to this file so that we may coordinate with that individual.
We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded
statements, telematics or dash camera data, vehicle inspection and repair records, and any electronic communications concerning
the incident. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these materials. We look forward to
your prompt written response.
Sincerely,
David Richardson
Kennedy & Johnson LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
